## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.Motor(value="reverse", label="Motor reverse", mode="indicator", tag="M-3")
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `commands` | array of string | `["forward","reverse","stop"]` | host | Commands offered on the faceplate (a constant of each widget). |
| `value` | `"stopped"`, `"forward"`, `"reverse"`, `"fault"` | `"stopped"` | host | Motor state (feedback from the process). |
| `animate` | boolean | `true` | host | Animate while turning (off when reduced motion is requested). |
